function.name: verify_resolution
function.arguments: {"affected_service": "cert-manager", "failure_type": "cert_expiry", "root_cause": "cert-manager failed to auto-renew the billing-service/client-cert because the ACME DNS-01 challenge via Route53 kept timing out (60s propagation_timeout, TXT record not visible). After 3 consecutive renewal failures, the certificate expired, causing all outbound mTLS handshakes from billing-service to user-data-service to be rejected with x509 certificate expired errors. This triggered the api-service circuit breaker to open on billing endpoints, driving a ~63% system-wide error rate. Fixed by issuing an emergency certificate via HTTP-01 challenge and reloading/clearing the TLS session cache on billing-service."}
